value: A residual closure attempt on a typed carrier C exhibits CTMT when available operational identities and structural reductions reduce the closure question to a carrier-native matrix-element family M(alpha,beta,gamma)=<a_alpha,P_beta b_gamma>, and inherited records do not supply enough kernel/transport data to compute M or make the M-decision target-equivalent.
legal generators; zero evaluators; packet atoms; pulled evaluators
carrier projections; typed transports; operational kernels
CTMT does not prove RH, does not close a residual by itself, and does not promote public shadows.
